system.description:
You enter the stance of a batter and swing your weapon towards your target making a Taijutsu melee attack. On a hit, you deal your [Weapons damage] + 4d10 and the affected creature must make a Strength saving throw, being knocked back 40 feet away from you. If you have Fury, you can spend it to first move up to 20 feet before making your attack. This movement does not trigger attacks of opportunities.

Chain 1: This attack has a +1 bonus to its critical threat range.

Chain 2: On a critical hit, the affected creature cannot take a reaction until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast above C-rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d10.
